mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially reducing benazepril metabolite (benazeprilat) formation and efficacy, while also having mild anticoagulant properties that may potentiate ACE inhibitor effects on blood pressure.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; benazepril efficacy may be reduced; consider alternative antidepressant or discontinue St. John's Wort if blood pressure control becomes inadequate.
